title: Jerk Tagine Chicken
description: A fusion of Jamaican and North African flavors, this dish combines the spicy jerk seasoning with the richness of feta cheese.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Sprinkle the jerk seasoning over the chicken and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Transfer the chicken to a baking dish and top with feta cheese.
Pour the tagine sauce over the chicken and cover with foil.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
